verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs directly state that a card can be frozen instantly from the Cards screen in the app and a replacement ordered there, with delivery in about 5–7 business days. Issuing cards to team members makes this relevant to a finance lead managing team spend. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the freeze/replace flow, and fuller documentation (only a single support line, with no detail on admin freezing of team members' cards or expedited replacement).

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly freeze a lost or stolen card and order a replacement

citations.quote: Open Cards in the app to freeze it instantly and order a replacement — it typically arrives in 5–7 business days.
Issue debit and credit cards to team members.
